answer: Submission rate is limited to 4 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole farm from one uplink. An operator running many aliases therefore burns for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the saffron quota and the trellis admission check. Because the counters live in the willow ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden.
